‘When he saw the wind boisterous’

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

‘When he saw the wind boisterous he was afraid,’ etc.—M
ATT. 
XIV
.
P
ETER!
 doubt, and thou sinkest! O believe;
The sea will not thy faith, Peter, deceive.
Things by their weight subside into the wave;
Thy lightness, Peter, threats a wat’ry grave.
